title: Surreal Cosmic Cliff
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a large split orb on a rocky cliff edge, with a green dog-like creature wearing an ornate collar standing atop a giant stylized face. To the left, a flowing female figure in a pink dress reaches toward a radiant sun against a pink sky, while the right side shows a waterfall cascading into a river with a treehouse on a mountainside.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a giant split orb resting on a cliff edge, the orb contains a stylized human face with mustache and fangs, a green dog-like creature with red eyes and ornate collar stands on the face, to the left a graceful woman in flowing pink robes with long turquoise hair reaches toward a bright sun, right side features a blue waterfall flowing from mountains into a river with a wooden treehouse nestled in a tree on the mountainside, dramatic pink and blue sky with celestial bodies, vibrant colors, symbolic composition
